fusions.name: Meat for the Table
fusions.desc: Throws a hunting javelin that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Skewers for Everyone
fusions.desc: Throws 3 skewers at once in a spread out to 6 tiles, and each deals 3 damage. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Carved Off the Spit
fusions.desc: Carves the roast and shares it out: it restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Its healing rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Game Bag
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (15% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
